cam_evaluations_criteria_consistency.name: cam_evaluations_criteria_consistency
cam_evaluations_criteria_consistency.value:
(
        not "cam_evaluations"."acute_onset"
        and "cam_evaluations"."inattention" is null
        and "cam_evaluations"."disorganized_thinking" is null
        and "cam_evaluations"."altered_consciousness" is null
        and "cam_evaluations"."stopped_at_criterion" = 'acute_onset'
        and not "cam_evaluations"."is_delirium_likely"
      ) or (
        "cam_evaluations"."acute_onset"
        and "cam_evaluations"."inattention" = false
        and "cam_evaluations"."disorganized_thinking" is null
        and "cam_evaluations"."altered_consciousness" is null
        and "cam_evaluations"."stopped_at_criterion" = 'inattention'
        and not "cam_evaluations"."is_delirium_likely"
      ) or (
        "cam_evaluations"."acute_onset"
        and "cam_evaluations"."inattention"
        and "cam_evaluations"."disorganized_thinking" is not null
        and "cam_evaluations"."altered_consciousness" is not null
        and "cam_evaluations"."stopped_at_criterion" is null
        and "cam_evaluations"."is_delirium_likely" = ("cam_evaluations"."disorganized_thinking" or "cam_evaluations"."altered_consciousness")
      )

physical_evaluations_pain_dependency.name: physical_evaluations_pain_dependency
physical_evaluations_pain_dependency.value:
(
        "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_score" > 0
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_cause" is not null
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_location" is not null
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_intensity" is not null
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_type" is not null
      ) or (
        "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_score" = 0
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_cause" is null
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_location" is null
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_intensity" is null
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pain_type" is null
      )

physical_evaluations_pressure_ulcer_depe.name: physical_evaluations_pressure_ulcer_dependency
physical_evaluations_pressure_ulcer_depe.value:
(
        "physical_admission_evaluations"."has_pressure_ulcers"
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pressure_ulcer_stage" in ('I', 'II', 'III', 'IV')
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pressure_ulcer_location" is not null
      ) or (
        not "physical_admission_evaluations"."has_pressure_ulcers"
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pressure_ulcer_stage" is null
        and "physical_admission_evaluations"."pressure_ulcer_location" is null
      )

system_settings_daily_evolution_edit_win.name: system_settings_daily_evolution_edit_window_format
system_settings_daily_evolution_edit_win.value:
"system_settings"."key" <> 'daily_evolution_edit_window' or "system_settings"."value" = '{"mode": "immediate"}'::jsonb or (
        "system_settings"."value" ->> 'mode' = 'duration'
        and ("system_settings"."value" - 'mode' - 'amount' - 'unit') = '{}'::jsonb
        and jsonb_typeof("system_settings"."value" -> 'amount') = 'number'
        and ("system_settings"."value" ->> 'amount') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
        and (
          ("system_settings"."value" ->> 'unit' = 'minutes' and ("system_settings"."value" ->> 'amount')::numeric <= 43200)
          or ("system_settings"."value" ->> 'unit' = 'hours' and ("system_settings"."value" ->> 'amount')::numeric <= 720)
          or ("system_settings"."value" ->> 'unit' = 'days' and ("system_settings"."value" ->> 'amount')::numeric <= 30)
        )
      )
